protocol_to_notebook.name: protocol_to_notebook
protocol_to_notebook.description: Performed lab work -> notebook page or lab-record documentation.
protocol_to_notebook.rules: Requires notebook, record, or documentation intent for work already done. Standalone how-to protocol requests are science questions.
protocol_to_notebook.example_input: I did the HEK293 transfection for Atlas today. Can you turn it into a notebook page?

specific_output_append.protocol_candidates: Populate with 1 to 3 likely protocol names inferred from the request.

notebook_draft.name: notebook_draft
notebook_draft.description: Future planned experiment -> planned notebook page.
notebook_draft.rules: Requires a requested notebook draft tied to a project, workflow, or next step. Not for standalone how-to protocols.
notebook_draft.example_input: What should I do next for Atlas, and can you draft tomorrow's notebook page for it?

specific_output_append.protocol_candidates: Populate with 1 to 3 likely protocol names inferred from the next-step planning request.
specific_output_append.entities.project_name: Populate when a project name is explicit or strongly implied.
specific_output_append.entities.workflow_step: Populate when the user refers to a workflow stage, next step, or continuation point.
specific_output_append.entities.protocol_name: Populate when the user explicitly names the protocol to draft.

inventory_lookup.name: inventory_lookup
inventory_lookup.description: Stock availability, reagent identity, location, supplier metadata, or stored chemical records.
inventory_lookup.rules: Use inventory_search for normalized query terms and aliases.
inventory_lookup.example_input: Do we have PEI in stock, and where is it?

specific_output_append.inventory_search: Populate normalized_query, candidate_terms, aliases, and search_mode for inventory search.

notebook_lookup.name: notebook_lookup
notebook_lookup.description: Stored notebook entries, prior notebook results, notebook pages for a project, or notebook records tied to a protocol.
notebook_lookup.rules: Use protocol, project, and result-text hints only when they narrow notebook search. Prefer protocol lookup for protocol records and paper tools for paper records.
notebook_lookup.example_input: What did we write last time in the notebook for antibody conjugation?

specific_output_append.entities.project_name: Populate when the request is scoped to a project.
specific_output_append.entities.protocol_name: Populate when the request names a protocol.
specific_output_append.entities.notebook_name: Populate when the request names a notebook page or entry.
specific_output_append.entities.requested_output: Populate when the user asks for a specific notebook result or output.

project_science_question.name: project_science_question
project_science_question.description: Science question tied to an active or named project, experiment, workflow, or stored record.
project_science_question.rules: Return reasoning_effort. Include direct_answer only at effort 0. Include project/protocol hints only when useful.
project_science_question.example_input: Why did the Atlas binder lose expression after transfection?

specific_output_append.reasoning_effort: Default to 1. Use 0 only for direct stable background answers that do not need project evidence or retrieval. Use 2 for broad synthesis, comparison, or recent-source-heavy reasoning.
specific_output_append.direct_answer: When reasoning_effort is 0, provide the actual user-facing answer here. Otherwise set to null.
specific_output_append.entities.project_name: Populate when a project name is explicit or strongly implied.
specific_output_append.entities.protocol_name: Populate when protocol context is explicit and useful.

general_science_question.name: general_science_question
general_science_question.description: Science question or experimental how-to not tied to project records.
general_science_question.rules: Standalone detailed wet-lab protocol requests go here unless notebook/record output is requested. Return reasoning_effort; direct_answer only at effort 0.
general_science_question.example_input: How do I express TEV protease? Give me a detailed protocol.

specific_output_append.reasoning_effort: Default to 1. Use 0 only for direct stable background answers with no retrieval need. Use 2 for broad synthesis, comparison, or freshness-sensitive reasoning.
specific_output_append.direct_answer: When reasoning_effort is 0, provide the actual user-facing answer here. Otherwise set to null.

paper_analysis.name: paper_analysis
paper_analysis.description: Analyze, summarize, extract methods from, or interpret a specific identified paper/PDF.
paper_analysis.rules: Include paper title and requested output only when explicit or strongly implied.
paper_analysis.example_input: Summarize the paper 'Engineered Nanobody Constructs' and pull out the methods.

specific_output_append.entities.paper_title: Populate when the paper title is provided or strongly implied.
specific_output_append.entities.requested_output: Populate with the requested paper-analysis deliverable.

literature_search.name: literature_search
literature_search.description: Find papers, references, recent literature, or external sources.
literature_search.rules: Use when the user wants sources, not analysis of one already-identified paper.
literature_search.example_input: Find recent papers on binder stability in mammalian expression systems.

specific_output_append.entities.requested_output: Use to capture the desired literature output such as papers, references, or recent findings.

purchase_recommendation.name: purchase_recommendation
purchase_recommendation.description: Recommend or find a purchasable item from external vendors.
purchase_recommendation.rules: Capture compact shopping filters. Do not repeat the base product inside required_attributes.
purchase_recommendation.example_input: Find a cheap metal-free endotoxin-free syringe filter I can buy.

specific_output_append.entities.product_query: Populate with the product name or purchase target.
specific_output_append.entities.required_attributes: Populate with a compact comma-separated list of explicit must-have product attributes. Do not repeat the product category or base item name here.
specific_output_append.entities.excluded_attributes: Populate with a compact comma-separated list of explicit banned attributes when present.
specific_output_append.entities.budget_preference: Populate with price language such as cheap, budget, low cost, or premium when present.

result_analysis.name: result_analysis
result_analysis.description: Analyze results/data, compute, fit, transform, interpret outputs, or write code-like analysis.
result_analysis.rules: Include compact task hints only when they help route the analysis.
result_analysis.example_input: Fit a standard curve for this ELISA data and tell me which samples are outliers.

specific_output_append.entities.requested_output: Capture the analysis deliverable such as fitting, interpretation, or transformation.
specific_output_append.entities.activity_type: Capture the analysis or transform type when it is explicit.
specific_output_append.entities.protocol_name: Capture protocol context when it is explicit and useful.

mixed_request.name: mixed_request
mixed_request.description: Multiple materially different tasks in one message.
mixed_request.rules: Ask the minimum clarification needed to split or prioritize execution.
mixed_request.example_input: Check if we have PEI, summarize the latest binder paper, and build a notebook page for yesterday's transfection.

specific_output_append.needs_clarification: Usually true when the user combines multiple materially different tasks.
specific_output_append.clarification_reason: Explain what must be clarified before safe execution.

unclear.name: unclear
unclear.description: Too vague, incomplete, or ambiguous to route safely.
unclear.rules: Ask for the minimum missing routing detail.
unclear.example_input: Can you help with that thing from earlier?

specific_output_append.needs_clarification: Must be true for unclear requests.
specific_output_append.clarification_reason: Explain the minimum detail that is missing.
